meta.topic: Preview matrix — every slide type, for the design-system contact sheet

slides.headline: Private label, without the *guesswork*.
slides.subhead: The 5 questions we ask every buyer before we quote — so you know exactly what to expect.

slides.headline: What mesh size and purity grade do you need?
slides.body: Mesh size and purity change how psyllium behaves in your formula. A capsule blend and a baked-good mix need different specs — we match ours to your use.
slides.whyItMatters: Right specs upfront mean your formulation team isn't reworking recipes after the sample arrives.

slides.headline: Answer these upfront, get a smoother launch.
slides.subhead: Five answers, five things that stop going wrong.

rows.name: Faster quotes
rows.rule: Specs in hand means pricing the same day, not after a call.

rows.name: Matched COAs
rows.rule: Lab numbers tied to your actual use case.

rows.name: Right-size packaging
rows.rule: Sized right the first time, no repack fees.

rows.name: Fewer port surprises
rows.rule: Docs agreed before the container moves.

rows.name: Mill pricing
rows.rule: Direct from the mill, no broker markup.

slides.headline: Ask for the lot-specific COA, not a template.
slides.body: A templated COA describes the product line; a lot-specific COA describes the bag you receive. The difference shows up in moisture, mesh, and purity numbers.
slides.actionBody: The COA date, the lot number on the bag, and whether the mesh spec matches your PO.

slides.headline: Psyllium is the fiber the others get compared to.
slides.body: Gel strength, water binding, and a recognized health story in one ingredient — that's why it anchors the category.

slides.headline: Inulin: the prebiotic workhorse, with a dose ceiling.
bulletCards: Clean label and cheap per kilo, which is why it's everywhere.
No gel, no viscosity — it disappears in application.
GI tolerance caps the practical dose well below the label claims.
slides.bestFit: Best when the story is prebiotic and the dose can stay modest.

slides.headline: The other three, in one line each.

cards.name: Sunfiber
cards.body: Clear, gentle, low-thickening — the beverage default.

cards.name: Acacia
cards.body: Slow fermentation, low gas, mild positioning.

cards.name: Fenugreek
cards.body: Viscous with a metabolic story, if flavor allows.

slides.headline: Match the fiber to the job.
slides.blendNote: Blends work: psyllium for structure plus a gentle soluble fiber for the label is a common pairing.

slides.headline: Start with a *sample*, not a sales pitch.
slides.body: Tell us your mesh size, application, and timeline. Free sample and COA review, direct from the mill.

slides.headline: One mill. One *COA*. No middlemen.
slides.statOrQuote: "The spec you approve is the spec that ships."
slides.body: Private-label psyllium direct from Gujarat — samples, COAs, and export docs from one desk.
